fnol_text: My name is Tomas Raman and I live at 898 Larkspur Avenue, Dover, DE 19975. You can reach me on (555) 609-7545 or tomas.raman@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 1 June 2024. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2023-00011. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Raman on (555) 609-7545 to acknowledge the claim. Tomas confirmed the loss date as 1 June 2024.
Site visit to 898 Larkspur Avenue. Neighbour Rafael Mensah was present and confirmed the timeline.
Tomas sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
